race.description: Adelaide Hotel Legend Of The Sth Calcutta Oct 1st Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: PERUNO (6) jumped in trip when he recorded a strong on-pace win over 2010m here from the good gate. Drops in trip for this and gets the services of Gorton's 3kg claim. Saves his best for the home track and confidence is high. THE ARROW (3) is deep into the campaign and due for a change of luck. Covered ground up on the pace with a gritty third over this trip at Goulburn. Maps well from the inside gate and has solid winning prospects. HARDAZHELL (8) has returned to form in his last two outings and drops back to his pet trip today. Finds a suitable race and can run into the placings from the awkward barrier. NAGADEC (10) ready for this trip fifth up on the quick backup. Strong through the line when fourth over 1460m at Queanbeyan. Should be around the money.
race.rail_position: Out 3m from 1000m to 380m then cut away rail..
